L248: Dear Customer From Aug 1st, 2026, to standardize a transparent payment process. Coway Vina adjust the RENTAL fee collection method as follows: the 1st period charges for a full month; the 2nd period charges for the actual days used during the 1st period (from the installation date to the end of that month) and is collected immediately, instead of being combined with the final payment of the contract as the current method.
